profile.title: Test Automation and DevOps Engineer
profile.primary_domain: Software Quality Engineering and Test Automation

profile_summary.roles: Over 5 years of experience in Technology and Software Quality, with professional experience across DevOps, QA Engineering, and Test Automation.

experience.test_automation: I have experience designing, developing, and evolving test automation projects for web, desktop, and API applications, as well as creating and maintaining automated tests, using Python, JavaScript, Java, Cypress, Robot Framework, Postman, and Newman. I also have experience building test frameworks from scratch, maintaining projects with more than 400 E2E tests, applying POM, Data-Driven Testing, tag-based execution, API automation, and integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines.
experience.quality_assurance: I have worked on requirements analysis, test planning and design, risk-based prioritization, documentation and execution of manual and automated testing strategies, as well as validating fixes through retesting. I have performed functional, exploratory, regression, integration, and API testing, as well as database validation using SQL.
experience.devops: I have worked on developing automations and integrations for internal processes using Python and Groovy, consolidating information, generating and delivering reports, creating pipelines with Jenkins and Bitbucket Pipelines, and maintaining and troubleshooting web applications, APIs, databases, and development, staging, and production environments.

profile_summary.profile: I have a technical profile, critical thinking, and a strong product-quality mindset. I seek to understand requirements, business rules, critical flows, and ways to contribute to reliable deliveries that meet user expectations and team needs, always working collaboratively and with a results-oriented approach.
profile_summary.objective: I am looking for Software Quality opportunities that allow me to apply and expand my skills. I value combining Software Quality and DevOps perspectives to broaden coverage, accelerate feedback, and increase release reliability, always focusing on anticipating and preventing issues, supporting decisions, and delivering value.
profile_summary.long_term_goal: My goal is to continue growing in technology with a focus on Software Quality, learning new technologies, frameworks, and ways to contribute proactively to the product and process quality :)

Investigated and documented defects, recording context, preconditions, reproduction steps, expected results, actual results, evidence, logs, and identified impacts.
Collaborated directly with developers to reproduce issues, analyze root causes, validate fixes, and perform retesting before new releases.

demonstrated_outcomes.achievement: Designed and built an E2E test automation framework from scratch for desktop applications developed in Delphi.
demonstrated_outcomes.context: The quality team was spending a significant amount of time on regression testing. The goal was to reduce costs with paid tools and free up time for more productive activities. I was responsible for identifying a combination of tools that could work together to create a framework capable of automating these tests. The framework was developed with Python and Robot Framework using reusable components, Page Object Model, tags, custom libraries, and custom keywords. The automated test suite was integrated into pipelines with Bitbucket Pipelines/Runner, and the results were published to internal HTTP servers (Nginx).
impact: Reduced regression testing time from an average of six hours of manual work by one or more QA professionals to approximately one hour.
Made regression testing less exhausting and more reliable; the framework was adopted by the team and served as the first hands-on experience with automation for several professionals.
Three QA engineers went on to develop automation for other systems and also contribute to the evolution of the project.

demonstrated_outcomes.achievement: Contributed to the evolution of a Cypress and JavaScript automation project that grew to more than 400 E2E tests.
demonstrated_outcomes.context: I started by contributing to test creation and maintenance. After the senior engineer responsible for the project left, I progressively took ownership of the architecture and technical leadership of the project. During my involvement, the suite grew from approximately 50 to 400 E2E tests in Cypress with JavaScript.
impact: Implemented Page Object Model, custom commands, tag-based execution, test data management, Data-Driven Testing, multi-environment configuration, dynamic waits, and automated restoration of the baseline state.
Restored confidence in a project that had become fragile, making its reports more consistent with the actual state of the product.
The solution made test maintenance and continuous test creation easier, allowing more time to be dedicated to creating new tests instead of only fixing existing ones.
The tests ran overnight and supported decisions about the quality of deliveries.

demonstrated_outcomes.achievement: Developed and evolved pipelines integrated into the CI/CD workflow for automated execution of test projects.
demonstrated_outcomes.context: I was responsible for developing and maintaining Jenkins pipelines integrated into the CI/CD workflow and Bitbucket Pipelines/Runner, automating test execution, environment configuration, Allure Report generation, and publishing results via SSH or WinSCP to internal HTTP servers (Apache/Nginx).
impact: Centralized results in Allure reports published on HTTP servers.
Provided faster feedback on delivery quality as well as an overall view of the product state.
Reduced reliance on informal communication about failures and made defect investigation and validation easier.

demonstrated_outcomes.achievement: Automated the preparation of Windows desktop automated-test runners with a Python and PowerShell solution.
demonstrated_outcomes.context: The solution installed and configured the entire stack required to run tests in the pipelines, including Bitbucket Runner, Java, WinSCP, Allure Report, Git, PostgreSQL, the product under test, and the PowerShell scripts required for automated execution.
impact: Reduced repetitive tasks by 80% and consolidated the procedure required to reproduce the environment, decreasing dependence on undocumented and highly specific knowledge while making future setup easier for other professionals.
Automated a large portion of the required setup, which could easily take 5 hours or more of manual work and specific knowledge across several tools.
